review.note: fixBase is the red commit, which holds every new regression (the guard refuses a changed .py or .sh test inside the range, so the tooling tests all sit at or before the red commit). reviewFindingsSha256 is the sha256 of .orchestration/reports/GRS-159/review-r1/report.md, unchanged. The named tests are the inherited GRS-154 browser-admission tests in tests/gate/browser-admission.test.ts that finding 1 relies on; the guard cannot bind run.sh or the JSON graph fixtures, so those regressions are listed honestly as unprotectedTests and are checked by the run, not by the guard. Findings 3 and 9 are documentation and evidence corrections with no executable test. fixBase moved from the red commit c4320909b97d to 79f4d077d4c9, the last commit that changes any test file: it retargets ten plan-coupled graph fixtures (and tests/agent-tools/make_tree.py) from items the 20 October snapshot records as Done to open ones, keeping each fixture's intent and finding kinds. The guard refuses a changed .py or .sh test inside its range, so every test edit sits at or before this base. The red commit c4320909b97d is the one that fails at the reviewed head: 82 assertions in tests/agent-tools/run.sh (18 of them from the four new graph fixtures run through verify; 952 pass) and 4 of 53 fixtures in tests/planning/graph_fixtures.py. fixBase moved again, from 79f4d077d4c9 to 5ce70df126d5, the commit that corrects the Python floor expectation and the ulimit capture test in tests/agent-tools/run.sh (found by the first full suite run at 5df7caa7).

findings.text: The live workspace lock rule assumes scripts/browser-lock.mjs (GRS-154) on every branch. It exists only on wave/delivery-controls; dev, wave/hosted-bootstrap, wave/tooling and wave/maintenance still need an explicit CLEARCASE_BROWSER_LOCK export, and a gate run without a slot does not count. Fix: branch-aware workspace text and a doctor browser-lock row that judges the checkout the way scripts/browser-lock.mjs does.

findings.text: claude_install never reads enabledPlugins, so a disabled Claude install passes. Fix: read the settings that govern the install (user; plus project and local for those scopes), refuse an explicit false and any malformed explicit field, fingerprint the settings, never fall back to another harness.
